name: Ahanu
summary: At Hewa's Armory, Ahanu helps couriers arriving in Thunder Bluff. He crafts and trades leather armor for travelers and young braves setting out across Mulgore and the wider plains, and shows new couriers the way across the bluffs.

sections.title: Merchant of Hewa's Armory
sections.body: Ahanu crafts leather gear in Hewa's Armory on Thunder Bluff's lower rise. His friend Jahan Hawkwing sends him hides from the Crossroads, which he works into durable armor for travelers across Kalimdor's grasslands. Travelers arriving by wind rider from the Crossroads can find him among the city's tradesfolk. He receives their deliveries and points messengers toward the local flight roosts.

faq.answer: Ahanu is a tauren merchant in Hewa's Armory on Thunder Bluff's lower rise. He sells leather armor and helps couriers arriving from the Crossroads.
Ahanu sells basic leather armor, including jerkins, belts, boots, and bracers. Hunters, rogues, and young adventurers can use the gear.

faq.q: Where in Thunder Bluff can I find him?
faq.answer: Ahanu works inside Hewa's Armory on Thunder Bluff's lower rise. Other armorers, leatherworkers, and weapon smiths work nearby.
In 'Ride to Thunder Bluff', young tauren adventurers bring goods to Ahanu by wind rider. Then he sends them back to Tal, the city's wind rider master.

angles.text: As a young tauren brave arriving from the Crossroads by wind rider, you can find a familiar welcome and hides for the road with Ahanu.
